276748077.description:
Hemingray Glass Company
No. 45 Glass Insulator
Pressed Glass, Clear, Vintage
A classic piece of American industrial history, this Hemingray No. 45 glass insulator was a standard component for telegraph and telephone lines during the 20th century. These insulators are sought after by collectors for their sculptural form and historical significance in the expansion of communication infrastructure. The No. 45 model features a robust double-petticoat design intended for high-performance electrical isolation.
Double petticoat construction for electrical insulation integrity
Clear glass with a subtle light aqua tint characteristic of period glass production
Embossed "HEMINGRAY - 45" marking prominently on the lower base skirt
Approximately 3.75 inch base diameter and 4 inch total height
Condition:
Excellent vintage condition with no major chips or structural cracks. Inner and outer petticoats are intact. Original gloss is well-preserved with minor surface scratches consistent with age and utility service. Threaded core is clean and undamaged.

277456575.description: This vintage calligraphy and technical drawing set includes bottles and boxes of drawing ink from Pelikan and Higgins brands, featuring Tusch Drawing Ink, T-100, and Black Magic Professional India Ink. The set contains a decorative black feather quill pen, a Speedball 'C' Style Lettering Set with pen holder and assorted nibs, a Doubleheader Calligraphy pen, a Sheaffer NoNonsense pen, and a dusting brush. Many items remain in their original packaging, showing signs of age and handling such as minor wear. Overall, the set offers a variety of vintage calligraphy and drawing supplies with some visible imperfections consistent with their age.

276861339.description: This is a natural petrified wood slice weighing 3 lbs 1oz. The specimen measures 4.5 by 4 inches with a thickness of 2.5 inches. It features light tan, beige, and black coloration with visible growth rings and bark-like texture. The wood is unpolished and in its natural form, showing surface cracks and rough edges typical of a raw specimen. Under UV light, parts of the specimen exhibit strong pinkish-purple fluorescence.
